title: Ice Sorceress and Demon
description: A white-haired female elf in ornate blue and silver winter armor stands in the foreground casting a spell with glowing blue magic in her right hand. Behind her, a large blue demonic creature with large curved horns emerges from an ancient stone archway lit by glowing purple and green aurora lights.
prompt: A beautiful white-haired female elf with pointed ears wearing intricate blue and silver fur-lined armor stands in a snowy stone ruin, casting a glowing blue spell with one hand while the other rests on her hip. Behind her, a towering muscular blue demon with large black horns emerges from a glowing stone archway. Dramatic purple and green aurora borealis lights the icy scene, with snow and frost covering the ancient bricks and torches burning with blue flame.
